speaker: player
text: Greetings madame, dost thou know of an apothacary where I might get a poultice?

speaker: npc
text: Well now, you're standing in one, aren't you? Unless you stepped through a portal and wound up somewhere else entirely, this is where you get poultices. What sort of trouble are you wearing? Spill the details, or at least show me the ooze. Don't touch anything though, some of these bottles bite. Upfront, by the way, payment, that is.
